title: HandwritingAgent: Language-Driven Handwriting Synthesis in Scalable Vector Space
abstract: arXiv:2606.18788v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Teaching machines to emulate natural handwriting styles remains an open challenge, as it requires synthesizing stroke sequences that dynamically vary in shape, texture, pressure and script - not only across individuals, but also within a single person's handwriting. Attempts at this challenge have largely explored deep learning methods in both online and offline settings. However, these approaches are often constrained by style-specific architectural choices, heavy reliance on large datasets, high compute costs, and a lack of flexible control over writing styles through natural language. To this end, we introduce HandwritingAgent, a language-driven agent that can synthesize natural handwriting sequences directly in Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) format with no need for style-specific training. translated_title: HandwritingAgent：可伸缩向量空间中由语言驱动的手写合成
translated_abstract: 教会机器模仿自然的手写风格仍然是一个未解决的挑战，因为它需要合成在形状、纹理、笔压和字体上动态变化的笔画序列——不仅在个体之间存在差异，在同一个人的书写中也会变化。针对这一挑战的尝试主要探索了在线（online）和离线（offline）两种设置下的深度学习方法。然而，这些方法往往受限于特定风格的架构选择、对大型数据集的高度依赖、高昂的计算成本，以及缺乏通过自然语言对书写风格进行灵活控制的能力。为此，我们提出了 HandwritingAgent，一个语言驱动的智能体，它可以直接以可伸缩矢量图形（SVG）格式合成自然的手写序列，而无需针对特定风格进行训练。该智能体利用大型推理模型对目标手写字符进行几何分析，并以自回归的方式将其生成为笔画序列……
tldr: HandwritingAgent 是一个语言驱动的智能体，无需针对特定风格进行训练，即可利用大型推理模型直接以 SVG 格式合成自然手写笔画序列，并可通过自然语言灵活控制书写风格。
en_tdlr: HandwritingAgent is a language-driven agent that leverages a large reasoning model to autoregressively synthesize natural handwriting directly in SVG format without style-specific training, enabling flexible control over writing styles through natural language.
